integrity: Analytical proof for all sizes and parameters; supplementary finite numerical checks do not substitute for proof. No claim of third-party validation.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight simple finite cycles, exact pinned coordinates, homogeneous nonnegative mass, and objectives of the grounded operator only; no general weighted/noisy-masked theorem. A known unshifted inverse-trace balanced-leader special case is credited to Fitch and Leonard. Absolute priority remains subject to discovery of an older equivalent spectral majorization result.
title: Universal heat-trace and Schatten-resolvent extremizers on pinned cycles
